entities.summary: Donato Ogliari, OSB is an Italian Catholic prelate who has served as abbot of the Benedictine monastery at Saint Paul outside the Walls since June 2022. He previously served as Abbot of Montecassino from 2014 to 2022, and has been a member of the Dicastery for Bishops since 2022.
